8233.title: Aggregate context updates discard measured breakdowns
8233.rootCauseOneLine: The shared projection selects the snapshot only from the newest usage event, so an aggregate-only update removes measured categories and the card's details toggle.
8233.proposedFix: Separate current aggregate usage from a historical measured breakdown and display its freshness; decide category-estimation semantics before changing the shared snapshot contract.
8233.caveats: Two clean projection and production React-rendering reproductions; no live provider or desktop send lifecycle. Chrome/Chromium unavailable, so no screenshot. Ring disappearance remains unverified. No safe simple PR: historical-versus-inferred breakdown semantics require a product/contract decision. Reproduction sources are embedded inline to comply with the reports repository policy.
